description_en: Queries one or more SAP HANA instances that meet the specified conditions
description_zh: 查询一个或多个符合条件的SAP HANA实例
kebab_example: aliyun hbr describe-hana-instances --vault-id v-000b0ov0000006zs --cluster-id cl-0001zfc00000050pr3 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tag Value=rg-acfmwutpyat2kwy Key=ace:rm:rgld --resource-group-id rg-aekz24ikcjyqjkq --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHanaInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码。从1开始，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The tags of the SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Code.description_en: The response code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Hana.description_en: The information about the SAP HANA instances

AlertSetting.description_en: The alert settings. Valid value: INHERITED, which indicates that the Cloud Backup client sends alert notifications by using the same method configured for the backup vault
AlertSetting.description_zh: 告警设置。取值为INHERITED，表示使用与备份库一致的报警方式

ClusterId.description_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance

CrossAccountRoleName.description_en: The name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
CrossAccountRoleName.description_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名

CrossAccountType.description_en:
Specifies whether data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account or across Alibaba Cloud accounts. Valid values:

SELF_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
CROSS_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up across Alibaba Cloud accounts
CrossAccountType.description_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持：
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份

CrossAccountUserId.description_en: The ID of the source Alibaba Cloud account that authorizes the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
CrossAccountUserId.description_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号ID

HanaName.description_en: The name of the SAP HANA instance

Host.description_en: The private or internal IP address of the host where the primary node of the SAP HANA instance resides
Host.description_zh: SAP HANA主节点的私有或内网IP地址

InstanceNumber.description_en: The instance number of the SAP HANA system
InstanceNumber.description_zh: 安装SAP HANA时指定的实例编号

Status.description_en:
The status of the SAP HANA instance. Valid values:

INITIALIZING: The instance is being initialized.
INITIALIZED: The instance is registered.
INVALID_HANA_NODE: The instance is invalid.
INITIALIZE_FAILED: The client fails to be installed on the instance
Status.description_zh:
SAP HANA实例状态：
INITIALIZING：初始化中。
INITIALIZED：已注册。
INVALID_HANA_NODE：为无效的HANA节点。
INITIALIZE_FAILED：安装客户端失败

Tag.description_en: The tags of the SAP HANA instance

items.description_en: The tags of SAP HANA instance

UseSsl.description_en:
Indicates whether the SAP HANA instance is connected over Secure Sockets Layer (SSL). Valid values:

true: The SAP HANA instance is connected over SSL.
false: The SAP HANA instance is not connected over SSL
UseSsl.description_zh:
是否使用SSL安全连接方式连接数据库。

true：使用SSL安全连接方式连接数据库。
false：不使用SSL安全连接方式连接数据库

UserName.description_en: The username of the SYSTEMDB database

ValidateCertificate.description_en: Indicates whether the SSL certificate of the SAP HANA instance is verified
ValidateCertificate.description_zh: 打开验证SSL证书开关后，表示验证数据库服务端SSL证书

VaultId.description_en: The ID of the backup vault

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the request was successful, "successful" is returned. If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页页码。从1开始，默认值为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页大小。最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
